summary: The main results are new material with no Mathlib or TauCeti counterpart, but several proof steps re-derive located lemmas (`Int.cast_det`, `Basis.isUnit_det`/`Basis.invertibleToMatrix`) and `Artin.lean` re-spells the generating set that `inducedCharactersFrom` already defines; the cyclic wrapper layer in `Spanning.lean` also carries two contentless restatements.
